slides.text: Your AI intake system works great for months. Then the provider pushes an update.
slides.voiceover_text: Your AI intake system works great for months. Then the provider pushes an update, and suddenly things change. Here's the risk nobody warns you about.

slides.text: Wrong question: which AI model powers your system?
slides.voiceover_text: Tip one: stop asking which AI model powers your system. The model is infrastructure, it's not the thing that actually matters to you.

slides.text: Right question: how do you test updates before they go live?
slides.voiceover_text: Tip two: ask how your vendor tests updates against real scenarios before pushing them live to your actual business.

slides.text: Ask if you can roll back if an update breaks something.
slides.voiceover_text: Tip three: ask whether you can roll back to a previous version if an update degrades performance or increases your costs.

slides.text: A good vendor treats AI as infrastructure to protect, not a feature to chase.
